reviews.title: Reframe: Tedious and Mildly Effective
reviews.text:
Reframe is an app that attempts to help people develop a better drinking habit or to quit altogether. Most of the daily readings are interesting, but the meditations and writing assignments designed to aid in focus, critical reflection and a deeper understanding of one’s inner world can be a bit tedious. They also try to push their coaching sessions on their users.
I would also caution anyone to purchase a year’s subscription. Try it for a month. 

Ultimately one should bear in mind that this group wants to make money. I was somehow stuck in a biannual plan that costs roughly $150 a year. After I tried to cancel they just gave me the run around: offering me services I didn’t need or want,
all the while saying they would make it right but never delivering and finally they quit responding.

Also you don’t need an app to quit drinking. If you truly want to do it
you can find the power within.

reviews.title: Exactly what I needed to regain control
reviews.text:
I’m so thankful I stumbled across Reframe!! After Covid, my alcohol consumption took on a life of its own. I knew it was a problem, but every day would be the same……I would drink, and oftentimes more than I should. 

With Reframe, the truth is exposed-that alcohol is a neurotoxin, and it’s not entirely my fault for what I was doing. That truth and Reframe’s education about the body, mind, brain chemicals etc. gave me the knowledge I needed to start making small positive changes.  I started by reducing at first, and that felt so good that I’m now working on 100 days alcohol free! 

I am still learning new things for my overall health. It’s like a wise friend walking along with me on my journey. I feel much more in control of my drinking!

This has all come about by investing in the Reframe app. Being in control and living a healthier lifestyle is worth it!! 

Trust me, it gets easier and feels better, all you need to do is take one day at a time with Reframe teaching and cheering you on.  

THANKS REFRAME!!

reviews.title: Game Changer in Changing My Relationship with Alcohol
reviews.text: This app was the game changer in helping me to stop drinking alcohol. I was on this journey for more than 5 years and struggled for more than 5 years to get more than 35 consecutive alcohol-free days. The community meetings and the coach that I got through this app made the difference. I am now 13 days away from living an alcohol-free life for one full year. If you are new to this app and/or your journey, welcome. If you are more seasoned, welcome. I highly recommend attending as many community meetings as you can. I have never shared or turned my camera on because I’m always doing other things, working, etc during the meetings. It has helped me tremendously to hear others’ experiences and relate to them. Working with a coach was a difference maker for me, as well. I needed accountability. My coach provided that and unconditional positive support, and encouragement. There was no iudgement after slips. There was only learning from it and even more unconditional positive regard. I cannot recommend this app enough. You are worth it.

It is more than worth the cost considering how much I spent on alcohol and what drinking can cost our health. From the zoom meetings I have made amazing friends. The science based learning has been so helpful in creating lasting change for me. If you are reading this you got this friend. Give this app a chance, you’re in the right place!

reviews.title: Good but could be better
reviews.text:
It’s good generally, but I think the generality might be a bit of a problem. It feels like it’s tailored only to people who actually drink a lot, which is fine, but that’s not how it’s advertised.
It consistently tries to educate me that if you have two days of alcohol abstinence, you may experience tremors and severe alcohol withdrawal. In the age of AI, I feel it should be reading my data and, as a result, not wasting my time by suggesting multiple readings about severe withdrawal.
The “cut down drinking” versus “quitting” programs seem to have no real difference. It treats my situation as if I’m quitting and seems to only change the wording in the text from “quitting” to “cutting back.”
I think this needs to be addressed differently, especially considering how the program is advertised.

reviews.title: 💚 This App Helped Me Find Myself Again
reviews.text:
I honestly don’t know where I’d be today without Reframe.

I joined Reframe in October 2024 because I knew I needed to change my relationship with alcohol. Like many people, I didn’t get it right the first time. But one thing I never did was give up. Reframe never gave up on me either.

What I found was so much more than an alcohol-free app. I found education, compassion, accountability, and a community that truly understands.

The coaches, the daily meetings, the science-based approach, and the incredible community kept cheering me on until I was finally strong enough to cheer myself on. That belief, support, and encouragement made all the difference.

Reframe has helped me change the way I think—not just about alcohol, but about myself. I’ve learned that cravings pass, emotions aren’t emergencies, and self-care isn’t selfish. I’ve learned to pause, breathe, and respond instead of react. Those lessons have changed every part of my life.

Today, I’m approaching SEVEN 🥳💥months alcohol-free, and for the first time in a very long time, I feel proud of myself. I’m more present with my family, more patient with myself, and more grateful than I ever imagined I could be. Recovery hasn’t made my life perfect, but it has made me capable of handling life’s challenges without reaching for a drink.

One of the greatest gifts has been the friendships I’ve made along the way. Encouraging others in the community has become just as meaningful as receiving encouragement myself. It’s amazing how people you’ve never met can help change your life.

If you’re wondering whether Reframe is worth trying, my answer is an emphatic yes. It isn’t magic, and it still takes commitment, but you don’t have to do it alone. Every small step matters, and every day you keep showing up is a victory.

Joining Reframe is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. It didn’t just help me stop drinking—it helped me start finding myself again.

Today, I don’t just wake up grateful to be alcohol-free. I wake up grateful to be fully present for my life. That’s a gift Reframe helped me discover, and one I’ll never take for granted.

reviews.title: Life Changing
reviews.text: I found this app stumbling across social media. I thought I had fallen for another gimmick. Turns out it’s the best decision I’ve made in my adult life. It was hard admitting to myself that I needed it, but I knew what I was doing was destroying my confidence and my health and relationships, whether I wanted to admit it or not. I originally sought out this app for medication. It’s been 30 days tracking on the app and I have not even taken the medication. Once I got past the first week of cravings and my vacation without alcohol for the first time in my life, I realize how strong I really am. This app had a lot to do with allowing me to be successful. Each day I have tracked and learned about the awful things I have been doing to my body through binge drinking and suppressing all of my emotions in alcohol. It is a quick and effective daily ritual. I have added into my day and it definitely helps during times of craving or triggering emotionally or wanting to drink the pain away and even boredom. I have learned so much science backed info about the affects of alcohol in so many ways to our bodies that I am officially disgusted at the last 12 years of my life. I have been drinking regularly thinking it was normal and justified. I have seen so much improvement in my sleep, confidence, mood, daily energy, and so much more from not drinking and flooding my mind with these inspirational stories, journaling, and having a safe space to really be honest with myself through the private journaling. It is set up to be very personal based on the patterns you report, it is an extremely effective tool each day. Now it’s only been 3 1/2 weeks dry but this app has changed my life. I plan to continue this journey in the following months. Absolutely recommend.

reviews.title: So grateful I found this app
reviews.text: I’m very grateful and happy to recommend Refraim as it has been instrumental in supporting my recovery from alcohol dependence.  The app is very user friendly, the insights and information about the brain and alcohol connection as wellas the supports available through chats, mentors and structured groups is all very well integrated into a powerful platform to support an alcohol free lifestyle.

reviews.title: #1 App!

reviews.title: Not impressed, but still trying …

Have picked up a few helpful elements in the past few days and slightly increasing participation …

reviews.title: Helps keep me on track
reviews.text: Not only does it help keep me on track it also has taught me why it was so hard to cut back in the first place. Just understanding the chemical process in my brain and body helps me to have more self compassion and understanding.

After over 500 days of using the app I have learned so much about myself and have a tool-box that helps me in my work and personal life at all levels.

reviews.title: I’m working on a goal
reviews.text: My goal is to gain control over alcohol. Reframe really is helping me get there.

reviews.title: Was skeptical, not any longer
reviews.text:
I’m only a week in but have looked at apps like this for several years. I’ve always been skeptical, maybe out of fear of what I would learn about myself or that it would be another plan that I didn’t connect with. I’ve been pleasantly surprised and impressed so far. 
Could be my age and where I’m at personally but Reframe feels thoughtful and encouraging. I’m enjoying reading the articles and having access to the group talks, those more than anything else. I’m really not alone on this journey.

reviews.title: Reframe was life changing
reviews.text: Reframe helped me cut back from 12-15 drinks a week to zero. I didn’t intend to give up completely but glad I did. I’ve been sober for almost a year now

reviews.title: Can we get a class action lawsuit against them?
reviews.text: No customer service to speak of. Charged me $132 for an entire year even though I never consented. It’s been 11 days and I’ve only received one email back asking if I want a cheaper plan.

reviews.title: You are not alone!
reviews.text: I have always had fun with friends with alcohol involved. As I aged, my body couldn’t keep up, but my drinking habit was firmly established. The people on Reframe are good people wanting to better themselves. The platform makes me understand there are many people getting through life, but know life would be better with less/no alcohol. I learn every time I engage on the platform, and my relationships, clarity and life is better because of it. Just know that as you age, alcohol suppresses hormones that would be in your body at higher levels with less drink. That alone makes it worthwhile to consider joining our community. You can do it, you are not alone.

reviews.title: Absolute ripoff!!
reviews.text: I signed up for a 7 day trial and they charged me for an entire year on day 8! I canceled it and they won’t give me a refund but they will cancel it in September 2027!! Ripoff! Oh and forget trying to speak to anyone who might possibly help.

reviews.title: Grateful for Reframe!
reviews.text: It’s been almost two years since I’ve had a drink of alcohol and I am grateful for the peace it has brought to my life. I do my Reframe app checklist every morning.  I love the support, life lessons, daily quotes and check ins.  I was ready to stop drinking and tried several times without much success. Having such a great resource with Reframe on a daily basis has made living AF sustainable and has changed my life on many levels.  I think it’s the gentle guidance, expert advice and continual support I really appreciate on a daily basis.  I can’t recommend highly enough!!

reviews.title: Zero stars

reviews.title: Great App!
reviews.text: This does a great job of staying focused on quitting alcohol!

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: I wanted a monthly subscription- and that is what I had believed I had signed up for. Instead I was billed $99.99 for a full year? I barely use this app and find it a lot less helpful than normal AA meetings. Very disappointed. Reached out to customer service and asked to be on a monthly plan and a refund, but have not heard back yet. I do not recommend this service/app.

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: I don’t think I could have cut my drinking back the way I have without Reframe. I appreciate reading the science of why it’s important. It’s been 30 days and I feel like a new person. Rested, healthy and hopeful. And I paid for the year membership four times over with savings on wine. Definitely money well spent.

reviews.title: 1/5 very disappointing customer service
reviews.text:
I would be extremely cautious when signing up for Reframe. I was charged approximately $100 for a subscription, and after realizing what happened, I canceled and immediately reached out regarding a refund.

I have spent several days communicating with customer service and providing the information requested, but I still have not received a refund or a clear resolution. For a charge of this amount, I expected much better communication and customer service.

What has been most frustrating is having to repeatedly follow up regarding money that is significant to me while receiving no meaningful resolution. The experience has been unnecessarily stressful and has completely changed my opinion of the company.

I will update this review if Reframe resolves the issue and processes my refund, but as of now, I cannot recommend the service based on my experience.

reviews.title: Freedom
reviews.text: Reframe has returned the gift of freedom to me. I  could not escape the loop in my brain of waking up each morning with my first thought that the two to four glasses of wine I drank the night before was bad for my health. I would promise myself all day long that I would stop today. Then I would reach for a glass of wine at 5:00 and the cycle would start again. This went on for more than a decade. I was a prisoner of my own thoughts not knowing how to break out of this bad habit jail. I joined Reframe three months ago, and I have cut back on my daily drinking by 90%. Short science based daily readings on the Reframe app, the nonjudgmental community on Reframe, and the easy to navigate app have given me my freedom back. It has taught me how to take positive steps in the right direction for my physical, mental, emotional and spiritual health.

reviews.title: Pill pushers and thieves

Take advantage of free subscribers with no notice and taking $132. Misleading marketing

Also just a front to try and push pills to make you think you need more medication and more drugs to fix your current addiction.

reviews.title: Shame on me.
reviews.text: This has nothing to do with the service. This is about the cancellation.  The content and tools are very good in my opinion, and I’m sure quite helpful for many people, they just weren’t best for me.  After my free trial, I started the cancellation process online. I was run through no less than seven pages of trying to keep my business, offering discounts and asking me if I’m sure several times. I must not have gotten to the eighth page correctly as I was charged the full subscription amount a few days later. I’ve been contacted email support asking to be canceled and requesting a refund that was 12 days ago. The first response I got was 24 hours later stating that they were looking into my “issue”. Two days after that, I received a response asking to “get on the same page” (the title of my email was please cancel and refund), and asking if I would want the discounted price or switching to a monthly subscription instead.  I replied I’d prefer to cancel and receive a refund. That was eight days ago. Five days ago, I asked them for an update. Ghosted. Hope this helps someone out there - be vigilant when canceling and get an email receipt.

reviews.title: Life-saving community
reviews.text: I needed to get alcohol out of my life, and I needed the knowledge and communal support to make that happen.  I have learned more than I could have imagined about addiction and about myself, and the community is the kindest group of people I’ve ever been part of.

reviews.title: Life Changing
reviews.text: This app has completely changed my life. When you first join it does a little evaluation of your current habits and then has you set goals, you can either choose to reduce or cut back or quit completely and you can change what your goals are over time based on what you learn. There are daily exercises to do that teach the science behind what alcohol does to your body and brain and emotions, have you log your emotions and drinks and had motivational quotes. There are virtual meetings and courses. Within the first 2 months I cut back by 80% and was feeling so good I decided to quit completely and my whole life has become brighter, more positive and amazing. I highly highly recommend this app. It lets you set your own path and doesn’t require perfection but gently guides and provides education and support needed to totally reframe your relationship with alcohol, whatever that looks like for each individual.

reviews.title: Wouldn't have made it without them
reviews.text: Tried multiple times to quit would make like 4-5 days downloaded this app the all day long meetings, the forum and buddies you make, the courses you can or don't have to do but you earn coins I love I look forward to them everyday I didn't realize alcohol affected more than your liver you learn so much courses on parenting, helping heal your brain, ptsd, etc and the done down I love seeing how many days I've made it when I'm feeling an urge I go straight to reframe see if there's a meeting or go to the forum the community is always there and has your back to help you along your way and I have a 1:1 coach what a life saver

reviews.title: It works but it could be better
reviews.text: It works for the most part. It did help me in the beginning to stop drinking. But it's glitchy and now my counter is way off. I keep losing days somehow. I reached out to support but the explanation didn't match the facts at hand and there's no resolution. I've switched to another app to ultimately track my progress. It's also odd that they chose the verbiage 'I stayed dry today' when checking in to log my alcohol free days. Sounds like I'm a child tracking the days I haven't had a potty accident

reviews.title: Beware of fraudulent charges
reviews.text: I downloaded this app awhile back just to see what it was about, although I’m sober and don’t drink anymore.. I then deleted it within 5 minutes. At 2-3am today; my debit card was charged for $99.99 from the app. I did NOT subscribe to any subscription, and I would know if I signed up for one that cost $99.99. What’s weird too is it was charged through Apple Pay, and I don’t see any transaction history from the app through the app story.. sketchy… Take this how you will.

reviews.title: A wonderful community
reviews.text: I’m currently over a year sober and a huge part of it was this app. Tried AA and it just wasn’t for me so I’m so grateful I found another sobriety community. Where reframe really shines is in its meetings and inclusivity. The meetings cater to many different communities, cutback, alcohol free, parents, helping professionals, creatives, lgbtq+ etc. The coaches offer lots of support and have found a way of being welcoming to all journeys and offering support regardless of what stage of recovery you are in. I think this is crucial to getting help for so many and I recommend giving it a shot. I’ve made real life sober friends in this community and I could go on and on about how I think it’s an overall positive thing for the world. IWNDWYT❤️

reviews.title: The Best Thing EVER!
reviews.text: Highly recommend giving this a try. It’s life changing!

reviews.title: Effective & Personal
reviews.text:
I have been utilizing this app for over a year. Everything has been straightforward. I received help < 24 hrs when I had a support question. One of the big pluses are the options to cut back or Alcohol free. You can count days, attend meetings at your convenience. Never bothered by app or notifications( I keep off). BUT most of all, the mtgs have been a huge support in my sobriety. Coaches of mtgs are experienced and VERY supportive.
Took a bit to become aware of all the classes & support & connecting with others. Much more worthwhile than I could have expected.

It’s like cheap therapy that also can help you save money you would’ve wasted on booze. Incredibly grateful for all that Reframe is, dig into it all!

The science, tools, meetings, and community gave me the knowledge and support I needed to change my relationship with alcohol. Forever grateful I found Reframe. ❤️ I 100% recommend Reframe.

reviews.title: Money Off The Back

People are more likely and willing to pay/support something they’ve seen actually work (especially through personal experience with the app). Not absurd to assume you’re like most apps who want my money, whether the app works or not. Btw, you should produce a policy that supports your “money back 200%” claim in the signup process. I haven’t seen one on it 👎

While that may be true, I am an adult that is capable of making my own decisions. I don’t need some random tech support attempting to tell me what’s best for ME. After reiterating that I wanted a refund, my last three messages to Reframe support was ignored. Unfortunately it seems like I am not the only person with an experience similiar to this.

reviews.text: Such a good supplement to individual counseling. Love the specialized advice, content, and community. Worth every penny

reviews.title: Made all the difference
reviews.text: Reframe’s community is amazing. Its coaches are wonderful caring individuals. Don’t skip the meetings. They are the best part I think. After many tries on my own, just cut back or stop drinking Reframe made all the difference. There’s no judgment. You don’t have to declare yourself an alcoholic every time you speak in a meeting, or you can just listen, just a group of people who have been there too. Their approach to helping you understand why you continue to drink even after you wouldn’t like to stop and what’s happening inside body and brain is really valuable.

reviews.title: On Game Point Tight

After the very ‘last time’ this popped up on my feed and I completed some research.  This app is truly amazing.  From the community down to the education you will receive, it is well worth the purchase.  Don’t be like me and have the ‘very last time’ or no time at all. You can do this and you will find the support and access to information, support, and tools you will actually need.

reviews.title: Best Sobriety Invention Ever!

It has answered the many questions about how alcohol has changed my brain and my body making the “symptoms” make sense. Thank you and I recommend Reframe for anyone who wants to change your life and your relationship with alcohol.

reviews.title: Logical
reviews.text: Reframe has taken the guesswork out of drinking and presented everything in a logical manner making it easy to understand what alcohol is doing to your mind body & relationships. I’m 30 days AF & loving it.

reviews.title: Newly sober
reviews.text: I’m only 7 days into my journey. I started using reframe and so far I’m really enjoying it. Definitely helps with the science behind it, accountability and motivation. Thanks Reframe!

reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: I had no idea if I didn’t cancel my free trial subscription in time I would be charged for a WHOLE YEAR. I am currently trying to figure out how to dispute the charge but they only have contacts listed as email and Instagram. I will be emailing them and also calling my bank during business hours tomorrow. I was really liking the app as well however this seems like a great way to take advantage of people struggling with addiction who are simply trying to seek help. Whoever set this system up should be ashamed.

reviews.title: Lifesaver
reviews.text: Well, worth the money one year subscription cost me what I would drink in one weekend

reviews.title: So Helpful
reviews.text: This app helped me so much more than I expected!

reviews.title: Amazingly effective
reviews.text: The community, the lessons, the tools, this app is very helpful for people like myself who want a way to go Alcohol free and want to do it through evidence based work.

reviews.title: Great resources and accountability
reviews.text: I almost never give reviews but signed up for the trial with intention to cancel but liked it so much. Three minutes reading and inspiration quote. Having to log drinks keeps me accountable  because I want to keep my streak. The community forum is helpful to hear others successes and struggles. Feels very real life for someone like me who is triggers are circumstantial - end of day, travel, etc. - and not quite AA appropriate.

reviews.title: Payment required
reviews.text: Was a good app to keep track of days sober. Unfortunately they got greedy.
